b01.base_model_licence_stated: mit (recorded for the reader only, never relied on - 2.2)
b01.quantization_mode_as_published: INT8, static post-training quantization, 128-image calibration, no retraining (model card). QDQ vs QOperator NOT stated by the publisher.

b02.quantization_mode_as_published: INT8, static PTQ, 128-image calibration, no retraining (model card). QDQ vs QOperator NOT stated.

b03.quantization_mode_as_published: INT8, static PTQ, 128-image calibration (model card). QDQ vs QOperator NOT stated.

b05.base_model_licence_stated: BSD-3-Clause, named by the card as the original licence (https://github.com/pytorch/vision/blob/main/LICENSE) - recorded, never relied on
b05.export_tooling: PyTorch PT2E static post-training quantization, exported through Arm's PT2E-to-ONNX pipeline (metadata.yaml description)
b05.quantization_mode_as_published: metadata.yaml quantization block: method PTQ-static, mode static, weight_bits 8, activation_bits 8, symmetric true, weight_granularity per-channel; README: 'a static INT8 PTQ recipe: per-channel symmetric weights and per-tensor affine activations across the full network, with no layers excluded'. Calibration: ImageNet-1k, 2000 random samples.

b06.base_model_named_by_repo: rtdetr-l (metadata.yaml base_model_id); no upstream URL is given
b06.base_model_url: https://huggingface.co/rtdetr-l (metadata.yaml base_model_id); no upstream URL is given
b06.export_tooling: not named by the publisher; metadata.yaml records quantization.method 'Other'
b06.quantization_mode_as_published: HYBRID. metadata.yaml variant, quoted: 'PTQ hybrid: static per-channel INT8 convolutions, dynamic INT8 transformer matmuls'. Nine named layer groups (sampling_offsets, attention_weights, reference_points, enc_score_head, enc_bbox_head, dec_score_head, dec_bbox_head, query_pos_head, model.0/stem1) are left in floating point. Calibration: COCO 2017, 64 random images.

b07.base_model_named_by_repo: timm/mnasnet_100.rmsp_in1k ('The model implementation is from timm')
b07.export_tooling: NOT STATED by the publisher. The card says only that the model 'could be supported by AMD Ryzen AI' and the eval command passes a vaip_config.json, which implies the Vitis AI / Ryzen AI ONNX quantizer - that implication is the collector's, not the publisher's.
b07.quantization_mode_as_published: file-name suffix '_int'; the card says only 'Quantized MNASNet_b1 model'. Static vs dynamic, QDQ vs QOperator and the activation/weight types are NOT stated.

b08.base_model_named_by_repo: torchvision SqueezeNet 1.1 ('The model implementation is from torchvision')
b08.quantization_mode_as_published: file name 'SqueezeNet_int8.onnx'; the repository also ships SqueezeNet_fp32.onnx (4956271 B), so an FP32 sibling exists for the reader. Mode not stated.

b09.base_model_named_by_repo: biubug6/Pytorch_Retinaface - RetinaFace with a mobilenet0.25 backbone, trained on WiderFace at 640x640

b12.base_model_url: https://huggingface.co/Semantic FPN (Kirillov et al., Panoptic Feature Pyramid Networks), trained on Cityscapes; no source repository URL is given
b12.quantization_mode_as_published: file name 'FPN_int_NHWC.onnx' - the NHWC suffix says the layout was converted, which is exactly the class of file that carries layout Transposes without attention; mode not stated

b13.quantization_mode_as_published: QUOTED FROM THE CARD: 'Quantization: Static UINT8 quantization, QDQ format'. One of only three entries in the round whose publisher states both staticness and graph format outright.

b18.base_model_named_by_repo: Yolo-Fastest-1.1 (dog-qiuqiu, 2021); the FP32 sibling yolo-fastest-1.1-320_float.onnx (1348660 B) is in the same repository

b19.base_model_named_by_repo: YOLOX-Nano (Megvii-BaseDetection), ReLU variant retrained by the publisher; the FP32 sibling yolox_nano_relu_float.onnx (9106175 B) is in the same repository
b19.quantization_mode_as_published: QUOTED FROM THE CARD: 'Per-tensor INT8 (W symmetric, A asymmetric); bias INT32'; 'Quantize INT8 (onnxruntime.quantize_static, 1000 random COCO val2017 ...)'. The '_qop' file-name suffix matches the publisher's QOperator naming in b17/b18.
